title: Hinomori Shiho — The First Notes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to score a ticket for this Iolite show.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're celebrating their new release, so I'm guessing they'll be featuring all their latest stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Phew.
That's two songs back-to-back from the album we just released last week!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's like they know exactly how to grab a hold of my heart and make it beat faster and faster...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I liked what I heard on their CD, but there really is nothing like seeing them perform those songs live. They make it so much more fun...)

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line:
You guys sound way too excited!
Our show's just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
But it's too soon for a break, right?
Why don't we play an oldie for them? Here's our third song, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's this song... Talk about a blast from the past.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I've seen a lot of people perform, but I've never seen anyone put on this kind of show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's the song from my story.
The one that made my heart dance and had me wanting to shout out loud.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Everyone here's screaming like crazy.
They're probably feeling the same thing as me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna immerse myself more in this blaring sound!)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: People who do what they love and put everything they have into making their dreams come true have this dazzling aura.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The aura I see when she's on stage, the sounds she can produce with her bass... None of that's changed after all these years. But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not like she hasn't changed at all...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She and her band have become a lot better since then.)

rows.Speaker: Audience Member
rows.Line: Yeah, I was on cloud nine from start to finish!

rows.Speaker: Audience Member
rows.Line:
Me too! Also...
Their shows always give me the boost of energy I really need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It really was a great show.
I feel just as encouraged as them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Iolite, my heroes... This is what they're capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But we're just getting started on our journey. The road up ahead is where we'll really be put to the test.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Right now, I'm still lacking in terms of technical skills and consistency.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I need to keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that I can catch up to her someday.
